title: Bayesian inference of molecular kinetic parameters from astrocyte calcium imaging data
author: Maly, Hofmann
materials: The Df1/+ mouse line, a transgenic model of the human 22q11.2 deletion [8,14], was maintained on the C57BL/6 J genetic background as previously described [18]. Df1/+ mice were kindly provided by Dr. Stanislav S. Zakharenko, St. Jude Children's Research Hospital (Memphis, TN). Primary cultures were derived from cortices of neonate hemizygous Df1 mice (Df1/+) and their wild-type (+/+) littermates (control) as previously described [16]. Specifically, the cortices were triturated, digested with trypsin (Thermo Fisher, Waltham, MA), and seeded in flasks (Corning, Corning, NY) coated with polylysine (Thermo Fisher).

For imaging, cells were grown in Labtek (Grand Rapids, MI) optical glass-bottom chambers coated with polylysine (Thermo Fisher, Waltham, MA). Prior to imaging, the medium was exchanged for Hanks balanced salt solution with calcium (1.26 mM), magnesium (0.89 mM), and d-glucose (5.6 mM; Thermo Fisher), and the culture was allowed to equilibrate for 40 min. In the experiments with thapsigargin (Thermo Fisher), the inhibitor was added to the medium at 200 pM on the microscope stage.

steps.title: Maintain Df1/+ mouse colony
steps.instruction: Keep the Df1/+ transgenic mouse line on a C57BL/6 J genetic background as previously described.

steps.title: Prepare primary cortical astrocyte cultures
steps.instruction: Dissect cortices from neonatal hemizygous Df1 (+/‑) mice and wild‑type (+/+) littermates, triturate the tissue, digest with trypsin (Thermo Fisher, Waltham, MA), and seed the cells into Corning flasks coated with polylysine (Thermo Fisher).

steps.title: Immunomagnetic purification of astrocytes
steps.instruction: After 1 week in culture, purify cells using the Miltenyi Biotech anti‑ACSA2 astrocyte purification kit according to the manufacturer’s protocol, then maintain purified astrocytes in ScienCell complete astrocyte medium‑animal.

steps.title: Transduce astrocytes with GCaMP6m AAV
steps.instruction: Two weeks later, add adeno‑associated viral vectors (AAV) at a multiplicity of infection of 100 000, encoding the GCaMP6m fluorescent calcium indicator (SignaGen, Frederick, MD), to the culture medium; incubate for 2 days to allow expression before imaging.

steps.title: Prepare cells for calcium imaging
steps.instruction: Plate cells in Labtek optical glass‑bottom chambers coated with polylysine (Thermo Fisher). Immediately before imaging, replace the culture medium with Hanks balanced salt solution containing 1.26 mM Ca²⁺, 0.89 mM Mg²⁺, and 5.6 mM d‑glucose (Thermo Fisher) and let the cells equilibrate for 40 min. For thapsigargin experiments, add thapsigargin to the medium at a final concentration of 200 pM on the microscope stage.

steps.title: Analyze imaging data with MIN1PIPE
steps.instruction: Load raw calcium fluorescence videos into MATLAB R2020b and run the MIN1PIPE package (default settings, version v3 alpha). The pipeline will remove background, generate an over‑complete set of seed ROIs, apply a two‑component Gaussian mixture model to peak‑valley differences, discard remaining false positives using pre‑trained recurrent neural networks, keep only the maximum‑intensity ROI among spatially close candidates, and iteratively apply constrained non‑negative matrix factorization (CNMF) to refine ROI outlines and deconvolved calcium traces. Set the structural element size for the morphological opening operation to 13 μm per 10 pixels.

substeps.instruction: Apply two‑component Gaussian mixture model to peak‑valley differences
Remove remaining false positives with offline‑trained recurrent neural networks
Retain only maximum‑intensity ROI among spatially close candidates
Iteratively run CNMF to update ROI outlines and deconvolved traces

steps.title: Infer kinetic parameters with CaBBI
steps.instruction: In MATLAB, install the VBA toolbox and run the modified CaBBI module that uses the Li‑Rinzel model as the evolution function. Supply the deconvolved calcium traces as input, keep all kinetic parameters at their validated literature values or allow them to vary around those values as prior means, and set the GCaMP6m dissociation constant in the observation function to 167 nM. Execute the variational Bayesian inversion to obtain posterior estimates of the calcium kinetic parameters.
